notes.title: Version 0.15 status and some thoughts about the next game.
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all![/p][p]
[/p][p]As I’m starting to wrap version 0.15, I find myself thinking more and more about Vae Victis - 2 (temporary name!) and there are two issues I’d like to consult with you guys about the next game’s design.[/p][p]
[/p][olist][*][p][b]Should there be less girls but more content for each girl?[/b] In his travels, Karder meets many beautiful girls but most of them have only brief interactions with him and are never seen again. While this allows me to introduce a huge variety of races, body types and backstories, the overall experience can feel a bit unsatisfying to some of you. A frequent question I get almost since launch is “when can we see more of girl X?”. There’s a dilemma here: more girls = shorter interactions with each. Less girls = longer stories, more revisits and even palace stay for some.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][olist][*][p]The other issue is about content affecting decisions: [b]should there be slightly more weight to decisions[/b] you make? In Vae Victis - Khan, very few decisions you make will give you a completely different outcome later on. A rare example is that if you abuse Alam or Fahda in the Ziruan oasis quest, you will not be able to revisit Fahda later. But in most cases, you will still be able to access all the content no matter how Karder behaved earlier. While this ensures that you will see almost all the content in one playthrough, it does somehow take the weight off some decisions and reduce the incentive to play again. [/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Since Steam doesn't offer polls for some reason, if you want to weigh in please you the following expressions at the start of your post so it will be easier for me to get a bird's eye impression:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Less girls, more content for each / More girls, less content for each (i.e. same amount of girls as now, no change).

Add more branches than there are currently in the game, decisions matter more / No branches, no decisions, I want to see as much content as possible in one playthrough.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]If there is any other thing you’d like to see different in the next game, let me know. As for 0.15: I hope to have an ETA for 0.15 next week. I’m also talking to a new developer, so there might be some good news there too.[/p][p]
[/p][p]As always, thank you for your ongoing support! If you did not get to review the game, now would be a great time to do so.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.15 Status
notes.notes:
[p][b]TL;DR:[/b] Next update will be released in [b]early October[/b].

[b]The Good News[/b][/p][p align="start"]The upcoming update will be a full overhaul of the Marbia quest, including:[/p][list][*][p]At least [b]40 new animations
[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]~80% of stills re-rendered[/b] with sharper detail and improved lighting[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Hairy/Smooth[/b] variations for Nahir, Alam and Domia[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Alternate model for Fahda (you’ll still be able to play the “classic” if you’d like)
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked dialogue

[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]sound effects[/b] all over the place[b]

[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Most of the Marbia-related content was created back in 2021, when I was still finding my footing. Looking at it now, I know how far I’ve come, and how much those early scenes needed love. Enclosing a very simple comparison of the same image, one currently in the game, the other from the coming version. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/933f9757f6e636761082a7d18822f69be9354b31.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/308eee48c4da5346a556b02e45989d69b11b7ce4.png"][/img][/p][p]And Marbia isn’t just the Ziruan oasis quest. It also covers:[/p][list][*][p]Alam, Domia's Ac2s[/p][/*][*][p]Fahda’s revisit[/p][/*][*][p]Nahir’s scenes and Act 2
[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]That’s a lot of content, and a lot of work. But the results speak for themselves: the renders are crisp, the colors more lively, and the animations really bring the lewd scenes to life.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h3][b]The Strange News[/b][/h3][p align="start"]You might notice I’m calling this update [b]0.15[/b] and not [b]1.0[/b], as originally intended.[/p][p align="start"]While I handle art, dialogue, plot, and freelancers, I’ve had a long-time partner, [b]Gojira667[/b], who has been working on the coding side, especially the world map and meta-game systems. Unfortunately, I’ve lost contact with him. My last interaction with him was on [b]July 26[/b], and since then… silence.[/p][p align="start"]Because of the privacy involved in working on adult games, I don’t have alternative channels to reach him. If he doesn’t resurface soon, I’ll need to find a new developer. Such is life in the 21st century of distributed teams, I guess.[/p][p align="start"]This doesn’t affect my ability to create [b]“pure AVN”[/b] content, but it does delay the final release. There are still key Khaganate management features I want in place before I can confidently call the game [i]finished[/i].[/p][h3][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The update is still coming, and since Alam and Nahir are among the most popular girls in the game, I think you’ll enjoy this return to the oasis.[/p][p align="start"][b]Thank you as always for your support, it means the world.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Version 0.14 — Late April Update 🔥
notes.notes:
We’re in the final stretch.

No hard ETA just yet — I don’t like to promise a date I can’t absolutely commit to — but what I can tell you is this: Version 0.14 is the biggest update I’ve ever made. It’s not delayed because of burnout or bugs — it’s delayed because it just keeps growing. And it’s almost ready.

If you’ve followed me for a while, you know I don’t chase numbers. I don’t post image or animation counts because I don’t want to feel pressured to inflate them with filler. I do keep track for myself, though — and let’s just say this version’s stats are... ridiculous.

💥 Previous versions averaged ~20 animations. This one? Already past 80.

Why? Queen Remy is getting not two but three full routes this time — which means more scenes, more variations, and way more content than usual. And if you’ve been following Karder’s story, you know he’s been obsessing over the queen for over four years… so yeah, I may have gotten a little carried away adding new scenes. No regrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/10a19310fd804f49fd6038eb1cff64378851dfbc.gif[/img]

🎮 On top of that, we’ve reworked the R/P/S interface — the flow is smoother now, with fewer clicks and better pacing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/d9537d2c1267d5b840c3166a97af610e4d2496ca.gif[/img]

Next post will include the final ETA. Thank you all for your support and patience — this one’s going to be worth the wait.

Finally: if you didn't Review the game yet, please take a few seconds to do so. Thanks!

notes.title: Version 0.14 April update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Version 0.14 is shaping up really well, and I’m hoping to share an ETA for release soon. This one’s big—probably the second or third largest update so far—so it’s taking a bit longer to get everything just right.

One major change I’ve decided to make is instead of having only Seduction/Dominance routes for Queen Remy, add a third path: Reluctance. In this route, Queen Remy is caught in emotional conflict—she doesn’t fully reject Karder, but she can’t embrace him either. She’s torn, and it adds a rich new layer to the story. It’s turning out really cool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/1fb09508a38a6b727eb144f58d676eb310f61f3a.png[/img]

While I focus on the narrative, Gojira has been busy with several awesome metagame features, which I’ll dive into more in a future post. Here’s a quick preview:

    Streamlined 1:1 combat with fewer clicks and stylish new backgrounds

    New unit types in MK2 army battles

    Varied travel times for units between fiefdoms

    Building construction times

    Portuguese and Chinese translations

    And four brand-new soundtracks for the big moments in this update

Karder’s first chapter is building to a powerful and unforgettable climax. Thanks for your patience—this one’s going to be worth the wait!

notes.title: Wow! Version 0.14!
notes.notes:
Version 0.14 will mark the end of the story for Vae Victis - Khan. This doesn’t mean the journey is completely over, but any future updates will focus on infrastructure improvements, tying up loose ends, and similar refinements.

[b]What’s Coming in Version 0.14?[/b]

At the start of this chapter, Karder stands on the brink of invading the Western Sister. But just as the campaign is about to begin, a key character vanishes, throwing everything into disarray. Trust among his closest allies is shaken, the secrets of The Harsh Edge remain elusive, and Karder even contemplates delaying the invasion.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/c52a600fcb2d26e6593cf4cf2a7b745f40242138.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/9082cb6cca3ed9b9f3bee8e82c3e75c132aabf67.png[/img][/url]

The climax of this update will feature a long-awaited moment: Karder finally meets Queen Remy. And yes, expect those “happy reunion” scenes you’ve been waiting for. 😏

But this isn’t the end of Karder’s tale. The story will continue in the next game, tentatively titled Vae Victis - Khan: Across the Sea of Knives. There’s much more to explore, and I can’t wait to take you there.

[b]A Different Format[/b]

This update will unfold as a series of scenes, without the usual map or mission structure. Think of it as a cinematic finale to this chapter of the story.

[b]When Will It Be Ready?[/b]

I don’t have a release date just yet, but I’ll keep you updated as development progresses.

[b]Sneak Peeks and More[/b]

As always, I’m active on Discord, where I often share thoughts, images, and ideas. Feel free to drop by and join the conversation!

[list]

notes.title: Version 0.13 final status
notes.notes:
In the story "[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/How_Much_Land_Does_a_Man_Need%3F]How Much Land Does a Man Need?[/url]" by Tolstoy, a peasant's greed for more land leads to his demise, as he dies trying to claim more than he can use. When I approach the end of a version, I feel like Pahom, the story’s protagonist: only I’m not driven by greed, but by the desire to push more content into the version: Another scene. Another animation. Another dialog. 

Anyway, content wise, the version is near complete. All dialogs, images and animations will be ready tomorrow. What’s left are the somewhat less “shiny” tasks of adding gallery scenes, music and lewd sounds in lewd scenes, proofreading, playtesting, reviewing the tutorial etc. Additionally, since we have added a Codex, codex entries need to be added as well (though this might wait for a later date).

As I have written in earlier posts, the quest in this version is about Karder who visits the Pirate Clans in order to secure their cooperation when the Khan’s navy crosses the Sea of Knives. Additionally’ we’ll meet the Harsh Edge, his divine daughter and will “reunite” with his little sister, Alyn. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/ee9d6f5b9b4b2d57aac837607a72ac2c101a3239.png[/img]

I may be able to squeeze in a lewd scene with pregnant Jada, but that may or may not happen. 

But after finishing this version, Karder will be ready to cross the Sea of Knives. It’s happening.

Looking at the new features, there are a lots of new surprises:

1. Codex. This is something which was requested many times in the past for various reasons, with the most popular being; how many children did Karder sire? And how do I know what bonus do my Council Wenches provide? So now the codex will provide statistics for this question, along with lore and information on all the Wenches, non-Wenches important characters, Deities, fiefdoms and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/222a241005a8d49aa9ce5e815c0ea4d36d14eeee.png[/img]

2. Threat Level and Covert Ops screen. Since the first days of the game, enemy fiefdoms attacks were always completely random. As of version 0.13 each fiefdom will be assigned a Threat Level (based on the ruling Wench) which will increase gradually. In order to mitigate the threat, you’ll be able to bribe enemy generals (with gold), execute a Preemptive Strike (“spending” troops from the main army) or declare Martial Law in your adjacent fiefdoms, thus forcing the enemy to cancel their raid plans but losing Morale (= productiveness) in your adjacent fiefdoms. In other words: the metagame will be less random, allowing you to plan your khagante’s growth better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/cfc0462d9de89e8c12f89fdd9ca1958b1ade4325.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/2d998c7dfa6f0669e92e4b2a8feadcbf79b33897.png[/img]

3. MK2 Combat formations. The Army Vs. Army MK2 combat, where you fight in 3 Vs 3 against the enemy will become the default option (can be changed in the game settings). In order to make it more interesting, the following “formations” were added.

Berserk: if your unit (i.e. on screen soldier) is not adjacent to any other friendly unit, it does more damage.
Shield Wall: if your unit is adjacent to another friendly unit (not diagonally), it receives a defence bonus.
Flanking: if two of your units attack the same enemy unit, they receive a damage bonus.

Don’t worry, I’m not trying to compete with Total War, just make the army combat slightly more interesting and fun.

4. Nicer nodes on the minimap in quests. Unfortunately there is no new minimap in version 0.13 so you’ll have to replay a quest to see this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639047/fb698c02a158c746b9847b64e7c3485229cd789e.png[/img]

5. Moving during a miniquest can now be controlled from the keyboard keys instead of clicking on the on-screen arrows.

6. Toggleable Incest. This is something I hear from time to time, some of you prefer not to have it in the game. Incest is now toggleable in the Fetish settings but the default is on.

That's it for now, now I'll go back to finish this adventure filled version. I’ll publish an ETA by the end of the week. Let’s fucking go!

notes.title: Adding a Codex: go for realism or gameplay?
notes.notes:
One feature that has been asked for many times in the past was to add a place where you'll be able to track the amount of children sired, as well as find information of all deities, fiefdoms, buildings, Karder's stats etc. So in version 0.13 we'll add Codex containing all the information specified above (let me know if you'd want anything not specified!)

But I'm wondering where to put this Codex. From a more "realistic" approach, putting it in the palace would be the coolest. You go to the palace and you click a link, like going to the Dungeons or the palace yard. However, we could also make it always available from the left menu, so if you're in a middle of a quest and wish to remember who Chiroz is or if you're in the world map and would like to learn how buildings exactly work, it would be easier to have that info exactly where you are.

So what do you think? Realism to Quality of Life? Have the codex accessible only from the palace or from everywhere?

notes.title: Vae Victis - Khan 2?
notes.notes:
Vae Victis - Khan will come to an end. I am not sure exactly when, but I believe I’ll finish the game in about 2-3 updates. I won’t reveal the end but I guarantee it will be satisfying, no cliffhangers or other nasty tricks. Which brings me to the question: what’s next?

I want to stay in the Twin Sisters continents for the next game. I have put a lot of effort into world building and I think it will be fun for me (and you) to explore it some more. What I’m not currently sure about, is what exactly will the next project look like. I have three rough ideas which I will present below. While this is not a poll, I would still love to hear your opinions on these ideas. 

[list]
[*]Vae Victis - Khan 2. This is the most straightforward option. In VVK1 Karder have beaten Queen Remy’s armies and have taken the throne but not the continent, but the rest of the Western Sister nations, whose armies are stronger, are still defiant, perhaps openly led by some Wakabian leader. This will have a structure similar to the current game, only you will have Queen Remy and Karder’s sisters at your custody.

[*]Older Karder. This will also have similar mechanisms as VVK1, but will be set in Karder’s future where, as an older Khan, he faces new challenges. Perhaps forces within the khaganate threaten to tear his life’s project apart or a new enemy emerges. The mood will be a bit darker and melancholy, as Karder reflects upon his life and perhaps strives to achieve one more great deed while he still can. While I have no intention to make Karder a fragile old man (he will always kick ass), he will also feel his age from time to time and his character will have a little more somber quality. Lewdness wise, it will have a strong, powerful “zaddy Vs. young ladies” vibe and probably less milfs.

[*]The AVN. The third option I’m thinking of is the most different from the others. From a storytelling perspective, one of the main disadvantages of VVK1 is that the abundance of ladies makes it hard for me to tell a long story, with twists, slow burn and emotional engagement. Although I do think Karder’s lifestyle somewhat resembles Genghis Khan’s, it is still not a good platform for telling longer and more engaging stories. 

Hence I’m thinking about an AVN set in the Twin Sisters continent, where the MC is not Karder. I’m considering having a young veteran of “Karder’s Reunification Wars”. who returns to his village where his mother is now the village matriarch. Due to the war most of the men are gone and the village is populated mostly with women, including his matriarch mother, sisters and other potential love interests. Perhaps his father has also gone to fight and his whereabouts are unknown, adding a layer of tension to the atmosphere. This option benefits from the Twin Sisters lore but will have a more classic AVN build.

[/list]
Fetish wise, all options described above will have the same themes you know and love. I love the option of choosing nobler and/or darker paths and these will still be present in any future game I’ll write. 

As I wrote earlier: this is not a poll, but rather an invitation to discussion. I also want to make it clear that nothing in this post is a commitment, consider it rough ideas. Again: an invitation for discussion.
